title: Documentation
description: Find GEKTOR setup instructions, task guides, CLI and workflow references, runnable examples and contributor documentation.

title: Your first run
description: Download GEKTOR, choose a workspace and run your first Agent task or a saved workflow that needs no model connection.

title: Work on a project with Agent
description: Plan a coding task, allow edits, inspect tool results and manage follow-up messages in the GEKTOR Agent. Learn how stopping and retrying affect your work.

title: Run and edit a workflow
description: Open, edit, validate and run a GEKTOR workflow recipe. Supply inputs, review paused steps and inspect saved results without needing a model for every operation.

title: Connect a model
description: Configure a local model server, an OpenAI-compatible API or a ChatGPT account for GEKTOR. Check connection settings and context budgets.
seoTitle: Connect llama.cpp, LM Studio or ChatGPT to GEKTOR

title: Reopen a conversation and manage context
description: Reopen a GEKTOR conversation, restore its workspace and manage long context. Learn what compaction preserves and how the Agent searches saved history.

title: Read documents and attach files
description: Attach files and images, read DOCX, XLSX and PDF documents, or download audio/video with GEKTOR. Check attachment limits, vision requirements and media dependencies.
seoTitle: Read documents and attach files or images in GEKTOR

title: Check an app in a browser
description: Enable Chrome or Edge in GEKTOR to check a running app. Set up browser dependencies, use a dedicated profile, complete manual login and inspect page results.
seoTitle: Check an app with Chrome or Edge in GEKTOR

title: Connect tools and skill libraries
description: Connect MCP servers and use skill libraries in GEKTOR. Manage saved connections, discover optional tools and understand skill loading and permissions.

title: Schedule and queue workflows
description: Schedule GEKTOR workflows and process queued jobs with a local worker. Configure triggers, inspect snapshots and handle reviews under the service permission rules.

title: Review permissions and changes
description: Review GEKTOR permission requests and policy rules before allowing an action. Understand run-scoped approvals and the limits of the workspace boundary.

title: Diagnose a failed task
description: Diagnose GEKTOR connection failures, failed tools and workflow editor problems. Find detailed errors and diagnostics before retrying completed work.

title: CLI reference
description: Look up GEKTOR command syntax, flags, profiles and Windows launchers. Run Agent tasks, manage saved workflows and operate the workflow service.

title: Configuration and stored data
description: Look up GEKTOR configuration precedence, profile files, stored data and capability-file formats, including executable adapter protocols.

title: Terminal controls
description: Find GEKTOR terminal menus, keyboard shortcuts, local commands and settings controls for Agent and Workflows.

title: Recipe format and execution
description: Define GEKTOR workflow recipes with typed inputs, data mappings, conditions, iteration, reviews, retries and reusable subworkflow calls.

title: Operations and tool limits
description: Look up GEKTOR native tool and workflow operation contracts, including document readers, images, archives, HTTP requests, artifacts and local programs.

title: Workflow HTTP API
description: Configure GEKTOR workflow HTTP submission and webhook routes. Look up authentication, request limits, error responses and idempotent delivery.

title: Agent stdio RPC
description: Integrate GEKTOR Agent through its stdio RPC protocol. Look up run, respond and cancel requests, event handling, permission gates and client lifecycle.

title: Build and contribute
description: Build GEKTOR from source and find contributor guidance for architecture, conventions, testing, terminal components, documentation and release packaging.

title: Project conventions
description: Read GEKTOR project conventions, including enforced dependency boundaries, code practices, CLI documentation coverage and the checks that maintain them.

title: Test and verify a change
description: Run GEKTOR project checks and verify session recovery in a real terminal. Find opt-in browser integration checks and links to the model eval runner.

title: Terminal architecture and interaction contracts
description: Understand GEKTOR terminal component ownership and interaction contracts for layouts, forms, menus, selection, inspectors and workflow graphs.

title: Write and maintain documentation
description: Maintain human-first GEKTOR documentation with clear article ownership, readable technical prose, compatible links and checked website publication.

title: Architecture
description: Explore GEKTOR runtime ownership across the Agent loop, model providers, tools, sessions, permissions, terminal UI and workflow engine.

title: Security policy
description: Read the GEKTOR security policy and trust boundaries for workspace access, processes, network tools, credentials and external integrations.

title: Eval runner
description: Run and interpret GEKTOR model evals using isolated fixtures and scored results. Compare tool use, task outcomes, budgets and available usage measurements.

title: Workflow examples
description: Choose a runnable GEKTOR workflow example by task and requirements, from model-free transforms and log reports to webhooks and model-assisted drafts.

title: Transform and review
description: Try a GEKTOR workflow that doubles a list of numbers and pauses for approval. Validate, run and review the recipe without a model or network connection.

title: Log error report
description: Run a model-free GEKTOR workflow that captures a log, extracts error lines and pauses before saving a Markdown report artifact.

title: Reusable report workflow
description: Call a reusable GEKTOR report recipe and return named outputs. Follow nested reviews and inspect the saved parent run without a model connection.

title: Local program report
description: Use a GEKTOR workflow to send captured data to a local Python program and retain its output and diagnostics in the run record.

title: Repository report
description: Fetch public GitHub repository data with a GEKTOR workflow, review a report and save revision-checked records. A model-assisted version is optional.

title: Webhook note
description: Submit note jobs to a local GEKTOR workflow service with authenticated routes and idempotency keys. Inspect jobs and stored results without a model.

title: Read a feed and save a draft
description: Combine a public Moltbook feed, model output and saved state in a GEKTOR workflow. Review the example requirements and keep the generated draft local.
